title: Bursa Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BTSO) says cyberattack gave unauthorized access to some personal data
date_note: The pages give only the day the chairman briefed the assembly; the attack date is not stated.
org: Bursa Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BTSO)
geo_basis: BTSO's home city, as named in the source
summary: BTSO Chairman Özer Matlı told the chamber's November general assembly that its information systems were hit by a cyberattack, and initial findings show some personal data was accessed without authorization. According to the reports, the chamber notified the relevant official bodies and hired a cybersecurity firm. Matlı said initial findings point to a vulnerability in custom software built under the previous management; the affected data is still being determined.
plain: BTSO's chairman says its systems were hit by a cyberattack and some personal data was accessed without authorization. Which data was affected is still being determined.
exec: A Turkish chamber of commerce reports a cyberattack with unauthorized access to some personal data; the scope is not yet known.

validation.note: Two independent Bursa publishers (Bursa'da Bugün, Bursa Hakimiyet) each report the chairman's statement; BTSO's own page was not read.

review.note: stronger than the source: hackers attacked -> hit by a cyberattack; flaw -> vulnerability per both Bursa pages
